item.title: Self-Hosted PPPoE Server: accel-ppp vs rp-pppoe vs ppp Guide
item.description: PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet) remains the foundation of broadband internet access worldwide. While most users encounter PPPoE as ISP customers, there are many scenarios where running your own PPPoE server makes sense — from building a small ISP to creating isolated network segments for testing. In this guide, we compare two open-source PPPoE server solutions — accel-ppp and rp-pppoe — and explore when to use each for your self-hosted infrastructure.
